::: {#def-bootstrap-ci-percentile}
#### Percentile bootstrap confidence interval

The **percentile bootstrap confidence interval**
runs from the $\alpha/2$ quantile
to the $1 - \alpha/2$ quantile
of the bootstrap replicates $\hat\theta^*_1, \ldots, \hat\theta^*_B$
(@def-bootstrap-distribution).
:::

::: notes
The extreme quantiles of $B$ replicates are noisy estimates,
so percentile-based intervals need more replicates
than the normal interval;
$B$ of at least $1{,}000$ is a common choice.
:::
